transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1630 Seven Springs Drive?

Sí, soy yo en 1630 Seven Springs Drive.  
Estoy bien, no hay agua adentro y no necesito ayuda.
Gracias por confirmar su situación actual. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Solo estoy yo aquí. No hay nadie más.

Thank you for letting us know you're alone at home. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No, no uno que no pueda salir solo. Todo bien aquí.
Understood, everything seems okay here. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, no hay agua adentro. Todo está bien.
Thank you for confirming everything is okay inside. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No tengo camión con buena altura, ni bote, ni asientos libres en un vehículo.
Understood, no high-clearance truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 1 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Sí, eso es correcto. Solo estoy yo aquí, sin agua adentro.
Gracias por confirmar, seguimos atentos. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
